actions.name: Sent spear-phishing email impersonating US financial institution

actions.name: Tailored spear-phishing campaign to spoof financial institution

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Sent spear-phishing email with loan funding theme targeting renewable energy company
actions.description: The phishing e-mail’s theme involved funding for a loan and instructed the recipient to download a Windows application to complete the loan process to receive more than $62 million.

actions.name: Sent spear-phishing email appearing to originate from UK financial institution

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Attached two PDF files to spear-phishing email

actions.name: Included link and credentials to download Windows application in spear-phishing email
